summary: Pre-deployment final verification sweep complete for Sunnah Umrah PWA. Backend 19/19 pytest pass. Frontend: every assertion in the 10-point checklist passes on iPhone viewport (414x900). FAQ page (/faq) renders with 6 category chips and 23 total Q&As; mistakes filter shows exactly 4, women exactly 3; faq-q-0 expands and reveals faq-source-0 citation; faq-ask-ai links to /chat; faq-back to /. Tour intro (step 0) has tour-faq-link→/faq, tour-reassurance, tour-glossary opening 12-term GlossarySheet; tour-reset NOT shown. Tour Step 1 has all 10 sections (tour-section-0..9) with all required text content (Start here, When do you enter Iḥrām, Clean & prepare, Grooming, Apply perfume, Clothing, Important reminder, ♂ ♀ symbols present, Forbidden AFTER entering Iḥrām, Out of forgetfulness, fidyah, Intentionally, BEFORE Tawaf, Nothing else breaks Iḥrām). Bold render via **word**→<strong> works (28 strong tags in step 1 sections). Legacy data-testid=tour-what and data-testid=tour-tip both ABSENT on step 1 as required. Chapter label renders 'Ihram' (CSS uppercase to IHRAM); progress reads '2 / 15'. Tour steps 2-14 all show expected section counts: 4,3,2,3,4,2,4,2,2,3,2,3,2 — every step matches spec. Persona commerce verified for all 5 personas (going, helping, in-makkah, learning, completed): all 4 tiles (home-travel-package, home-travel-diy, home-shop, home-best-months) present for every persona; legacy home-shop-makkah tile correctly absent (count=0). home-walk-haram 7th tile present for every persona (regression check). settings-faq link visible, href=/faq, navigation works. ZERO console errors across all 12 routes (/, /tour, /faq, /lost, /walk-haram, /settings, /chat, /places, /quiz, /group, /about, /privacy). AR localization verified: /faq header reads 'أسئلة كلّ حاجّ ومعتمر', first Q reads 'إن انتقض وضوئي، هل لا زلت في الإحرام؟'; AR tour step 1 still renders ♂ and ♀ symbols. Backend regression: /api/gates returns 12 gates, /api/gates/nearest with {21.42,39.83} returns gate+distance+bearing+others, /api/chat with Claude Sonnet 4.5 returns valid reply for 'What is Tawaf?'. All Stripe Sadaqah checkout endpoints (small/medium/large/custom + validation) and group create/join/checkin endpoints pass. Ship-ready for production sunnahumrah.app.
